settings.HomePageTitle: The ultimate ASD tug handling guide now available in two formats

products.ProductDescription: A premium hardcover casebound book. More than 70 full-colour images depicting tug manoeuvres and much more. Includes a free bridge display poster. Perfect for any ASD tug operator who prefer a hands-on reference.
A digital replica of the hardcover book, fully searcheable with content navigation links. Excludes the display poster.

home.HomePageBookDescription2: Whether you prefer the weight of a premium hardcover or the convenience of a digital file, The ABC of ASD delivers the same expert knowledge. This comprehensive book features over 70 full‑colour images, clear manoeuvre diagrams, and practical safety insights drawn from real‑world experience. The physical edition includes an exclusive free bridge display poster. The digital edition is a fully searchable replica, perfect for your tug computer or phone – always accessible wherever you are. Choose the best format for your tug.
home.HomePageItem1SubText: A physical hardcover book printed on premium gloss paper.
home.HomePageItem2SubText: A digital downloadable e-book with licence key for 2 devices

about.AuthorShortBio: The advice in The ABC of ASD is the sum of what I've learned, practiced, and taught across more than three decades on the ocean. Every book has an author, and every author has a voyage. Here's mine.
about.AuthorExtendedBio: Whether you're a seasoned master or a cadet on your first ASD tug, this book is your practical companion.
